notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Angel.
description:
Cast Artificial Evolution by paying {U}, changing all instances of "Spirit" on Bishop of Wings to "Angel" until end of turn.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing an Angel, adding {C}{C}.
Bishop of Wings' second ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Angel creature token.
The Angel enters the battlefield, triggering Bishop of WIngs' first ability, causing you to gain four life.
Repeat from step 2.
